I think anon subverses are a great feature for users who value real anonymity, but here’s why I think anonymous comments should not be mixed with pseudonymous comments (edited from a previous discussion on the same subject):

By having anonymous comments (outside of a fully anonymous subverse), you put the named comments at a disadvantage. It would encourage users who care about their fake internet points to only post popular opinions under their name and tick the anonymous box for everything else. Essentially the anonymous option means “protect me from the consequences of this comment”.

Anonymity appeals to some — those people already post on anonymous boards like the various chans. Pseudonymity appeals to some — that’s why reddit is so big, and that’s why you’re on Voat. I think the anonymous subverse is a pretty neat feature for Voat to cater to both crowds, but allowing the two types of comments to mix will create an uneven playing field that’s not conducive to quality discussion.

If there's a lot of back and forth, there's no way to know that you're still discussing with the OP or not. Could get confusing and weird if 5 people are pretending to be the same person.

There are other reasons listed here by people here that indicate why they don't think it would work either.

What might be a better option, IMO, is allowing alts tied to an account. Perhaps only allowing 1 to 3 or something. I mean, I get what you mean by anonymity; yes, you're anonymous in that you're not tied to a username, but when someone becomes well known on voat in whatever sub, but then they also like to peruse pornographic content of a potentially questionable nature, they'd likely not want that shown in their history, so they'd want to use an alt.
